note: What each PlayStyle and PlayStyle+ does, quoted word for word from EA (D-121 (4)), each with the EA page it was read from on 28 Nov 2026. A null description means EA’s wording has not been found; the site says to check it in game. Never another site’s text (rule 9).

sources.title: EA, PlayStyles: Everything You Need to Know (FC 27, 25 Sep 2026)
EA, FC 27 Power Shot Player Ratings
EA, FC 27 Power Shot+ Player Ratings

playStyles.name: 1v1 Close Down

playStyle.text: Unique reflex/anticipation save animations, increase in rush speed and improved read of close shot trajectories.

plus.text: Unique reflex/anticipation save animations, even greater increases in rush speed and improved reads of close shot trajectories.

playStyles.notes: EA FC 27 Player Ratings calls this PlayStyle Rush Out (trait2_8).

playStyle.text: Performs volleys with improved accuracy and has access to acrobatic volley animations.

plus.text: Performs volleys with significant accuracy and has access to unique acrobatic volley animations.

playStyle.text: Performs higher jumps and has increased physical presence before and during defensive aerial duels.

plus.text: Performs even higher jumps and has greatly increased physical presence before and during defensive aerial duels.

playStyle.text: Improved chances of standing tackle success and grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a standing tackle.

plus.text: Significantly improved chances of standing tackle success and grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a standing tackle.

playStyle.text: Increased reach when performing blocks and improved ability to make a successful block.

plus.text: Even greater reach when performing blocks and improved ability to make a successful block.

playStyles.name: Bruiser

playStyle.text: Greater strength when performing physical tackles.

plus.text: Even greater strength when performing physical tackles.

playStyles.notes: Title Update v1.3.0 (25 Nov 2026) keeps shoulder challenges and PlayStyles such as Bruiser focused on side-by-side contests.

playStyle.text: Performs chip shots faster and with greater accuracy.

plus.text: Performs chip shots more quickly with exceptional accuracy.

playStyle.text: Unique punching animations, increased hand strength and ball out speed from punches, prioritization of punch animations in contested ball scenarios, and increased speed for coming out for crosses.

plus.text: Unique punching animations and even greater increases in ball out speed and hand strength.

playStyle.text: Set pieces are delivered with increased speed, curve, and accuracy. Ball trajectory preview line is longer.

plus.text: Set pieces are delivered with exceptional speed, curve, and accuracy. Ball trajectory preview line is at maximum length.

playStyle.text: Unique animations when deflecting the ball. Increased power to parry shots into safer areas.

plus.text: Unique animations when deflecting the ball. Maximum power to parry shots into safer areas.

playStyle.text: Performs dribble Shoulder Challenges and Shielding with increased effectiveness.

plus.text: Performs dribble shoulder challenges and shielding with greatly increased effectiveness.

playStyle.text: Unique long diving distance jump animations and increased chances of saving long distance shots.

plus.text: Unique long diving distance jump animations and even greater increase in the chances of saving long distance shots.

playStyle.text: Unique GK throw animations and increased GK throw max distance.

plus.text: Unique GK throw animations and even greater increase in GK throw max distance.

playStyle.text: Performs finesse shots faster with additional curve and improved accuracy

plus.text: Performs finesse shots significantly faster with maximum curve and exceptional accuracy.

playStyle.text: Has reduced error when trapping the ball and is able to transition to dribbling faster with greater control.

plus.text: Has minimal error when trapping the ball and is able to transition to dribbling much faster with greater control.

playStyle.text: Exclusive foot save animations and increased performance against low trajectory shots.

plus.text: Exclusive foot save animations and even better performance against low trajectory shots.

playStyle.text: Fancy and Trivela shots are performed with improved accuracy.

plus.text: Fancy and Trivela shots are performed with greatly improved accuracy.

playStyle.text: Through Passes are more accurate, Swerve Passes are delivered with more curve, and Precision Passes travel faster to the destination.

plus.text: Through Passes are far more accurate, Swerve Passes are delivered with maximum curve, and Precision Passes travel at top speed to the destination.

playStyle.text: Increased reach and improved chances of retaining possession of the ball when performing interceptions.

plus.text: Even greater reach and improved chances of retaining possession of the ball when performing interceptions.

playStyle.text: Fancy and Trivela passes are performed with improved accuracy.

plus.text: Fancy and Trivela passes are performed with greatly improved accuracy.

playStyle.text: Increased max speed of Sprint Jockey and improved transition speed from jockey to sprint.

plus.text: Increased max speed of Sprint Jockey and greatly improves transition speed from jockey to sprint.

playStyle.text: Lob and Lofted Through Passes are more accurate, travel faster, and are more difficult to intercept.

plus.text: Lob and Lofted Through Passes are even more accurate, travel faster than ever, and are far more difficult to intercept.

playStyle.text: Performs throw-ins with increased power to cover a greater distance.

plus.text: Performs throw-ins with more power to cover maximum distance.

playStyles.name: Low Driven Shot

playStyle.text: Enhances a Player's ability to execute low driven shots with increased accuracy, faster ball travel, and quicker shot execution.

plus.text: Enhances a Player's ability to perform low driven shots with significantly enhanced accuracy, even faster ball travel, and quicker shot execution.

playStyles.notes: EA disagrees with itself: the FC 27 Gameplay Deep Dive (29 Jul 2026) says it removed the shot speed boost on low driven shots; this later article (25 Sep) still says faster ball travel. Check in game.

playStyle.text: Passes travel faster along the ground without impacting the trapping difficulty of the receiver.

plus.text: Passes travel much faster along the ground without impacting the trapping difficulty of the receiver.

playStyles.name: Power Shot

playStyle.text: Faster power shots with increased speed

plus.text: Much faster power shots with significant speed increase

playStyles.notes: Missing from EA’s PlayStyles article; text from EA’s FC 27 Player Ratings pages.

playStyle.text: Performs headers with increased accuracy and power.

plus.text: Performs headers with greatly increased accuracy and power.

playStyle.text: Keeps close control of the ball while dribbling at jog speed and can shield the ball more effectively from stronger opponents.

plus.text: Keeps exceptionally close control of the ball while dribbling at jog speed. Can shield the ball much more effectively from stronger opponents.

playStyle.text: Accelerates faster during Explosive Sprint.

plus.text: Accelerates significantly faster during Explosive Sprint.

playStyle.text: Reaches a higher sprint speed while dribbling and has reduced chance of an error when sprinting or performing knock-ons.

plus.text: Reaches even higher sprint speed while dribbling and has greatly reduced chance of an error when sprinting or performing knock-ons.

playStyle.text: Reduces fatigue loss during play and increases fatigue recovery during halftime.

plus.text: Greatly reduces the long-term fatigue effects on attributes, reaction time, and defensive awareness. Reduces fatigue loss during play and significantly increases fatigue recovery during halftime.

playStyle.text: Grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a slide tackle.

plus.text: Greatly improved slide tackle coverage. Also grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a slide tackle.

playStyle.text: Reaches a higher speed when performing Controlled Sprint and performs wide turns while dribbling with more precision.

plus.text: Reaches even higher speed when performing Controlled Sprint and performs wide turns while dribbling with greater precision.

playStyle.text: Executes difficult first-time Ground Passes with high accuracy, using backheels when contextually appropriate. Short distance Ground Passes are highly accurate.

plus.text: Executes difficult first-time Ground Passes with even greater accuracy, using backheels when contextually appropriate. Short distance Ground Passes are exceptionally accurate.

playStyle.text: Grants the ability to perform unique flick Skill Moves.

plus.text: Grants the ability to perform more unique ground and flick Skill Moves. Is significantly more agile when strafe dribbling.

playStyle.text: All crosses are highly accurate, travel faster, and with more curve.

plus.text: All crosses are highly accurate, travel faster, and with more curve. Performs driven crosses with exceptional power.
